reproductionBuild.result: Clean checkout installed and built solana-client, db, battle-engine, tournament, API, and Next.js.

secrets: provided separately through server environment / secret store

database.note: Database rows and balances are runtime state. Git recreates the schema through migrations. It does not recreate the live rows.

behavior.chainCupPayout: CARDS vault collected once to the keeper, then a 50/35/15 integer CARDS podium
behavior.twoPlayerChainCup: payTournamentCardsPrize pays the whole CARDS vault to the winner. There is no SOL tournament prize fallback.
behavior.solChainRail: sol_chain is the 1v1 SOL settlement rail and the chain-cup rail name. Chain-cup prizes are CARDS.
behavior.tournamentCapacity: Rotation indexes 0, 1, and 2 are 16-player events. Later rotation indexes are 32-player events.
behavior.scheduler: Disabled by default. Enabling sets one start anchor 30 minutes ahead. The live row is disabled with a null start and rotation index 0.
behavior.creatorRewards: CARDS creator fees split 90% tournament / 10% operator. Poll default 60000 ms. Minimum claim 1 raw unit. Signer path is not recorded here.
behavior.placeRecovery: A CARDS place payment persists the signed transaction before broadcast. The same bytes are rebroadcast while the blockhash can still land. A replacement is signed only after the stored signature is confirmed absent and cannot be replayed. Place 3 uses that path.
